title: AI‑Agentic Cloud Surge Meets Sovereign‑Secure Infrastructure: How AWS, Google, Azure, and Cloudflare Redefine Cloud Computing in 2026
core_insight: AI‑agentic workloads are becoming core to cloud platforms while sovereign‑focused security and compliance upgrades reshape the infrastructure landscape.

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出ECS Gateway简化容器入口网络，并发布Lambda Web Functions作为原生HTTP服务器端无状态计算，提升无服务器开发体验；Step Functions加入AI代理工具，强化工作流的智能化编排。Google Cloud继续深化K8s与网络诊断能力，发布《When the Kubernetes API went silent: A three-layer networking mystery》，展示对GKE网络堆栈的细粒度调试工具，并推出《What’s new in AI infrastructure and orchestration in October》，引入新一代TPU‑v5p及AI工作流编排改进。Azure发布《Evolving the cloud‑native foundation for the next generation of AI》阐述云原生 AI 基础设施的升级，强化容器、Serverless 与大模型协同；Cloudflare推出《Bringing post‑quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management》实现面向地理隔离的后量子密钥管理，提升安全底层能力。 AWS Continuum for Code Vulnerabilities利用生成式AI自动发现并优先级化代码漏洞，标志着AI安全服务的深化；Bedrock引入GPT‑6.1 Terra模型，提升大模型在云端的可用性和成本效益。Google Cloud Database Migration Service新增磁盘收缩功能，帮助用户在迁移后降低Cloud SQL成本，同时发布《The Rise of LLMJacking》与《ARTEX and Friends》报告，提醒模型与云资源的攻击面扩大。Azure在《Advancing hardware security with open‑source Integrated HSM technology》以及《Azure Cloud HSM Hardware Audit Logging》提供硬件审计日志与开源 HSM，增强密钥管理可审计性；Cloudflare的《Cross‑request KV cache exposure… remediation》展示对 Workers AI 缓存泄露的快速修复机制。 AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions What’s new in AI infrastructure and orchestration in October When the Kubernetes API went silent: A three-layer networking mystery Beyond Migration: Using Database Migration Service for disk shrinking Evolving the cloud‑native foundation for the next generation of AI Bringing post‑quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management Advancing hardware security with open‑source Integrated HSM technology
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Google Cloud正式推出Spend Caps（费用上限）功能，帮助企业在多云预算管理中设定硬性上限，降低成本不确定性；Oracle通过200亿美元借款上限加速数据中心CAPEX，暗示云算力供给将快速扩张。Azure连续发布《Advancing digital sovereignty with greater control and choice》以及《Designing for sovereign AI: A shared foundation from edge to cloud》，强调在多地区、监管敏感场景下提供可选区域与合规控制。 Marvell宣布斥资1150亿美元收购光子网络公司，旨在为云厂商提供更高带宽、低延迟的光互连解决方案，预示下一代数据中心光网络将成为算力供给的关键瓶颈。火山引擎通过《ByteHouse云数仓版》提供高并发实时分析算力，提升国内大数据计算供应；Azure继续强化 AI 计算平台，虽未披露新芯片，但在《Managing open‑weight model risk in enterprise deployments》中提及对多模型算力的灵活调度。 Innovate on your own business terms: Google Cloud spend caps now generally available Oracle gobbles $20 billion borrowing limit a week after setting it Marvell wants to be a copper topper, bets $115B on photonics leader to push optical networking Advancing digital sovereignty with greater control and choice 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵 Designing for sovereign AI: A shared foundation from edge to cloud
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce推出Health Insights，将AI驱动的下一步行动直接嵌入医疗健康数据工作流，标志着AI SaaS向垂直健康行业的进一步渗透；HubSpot将生成式AI深度嵌入营销技术栈，发布《Claude marketing plugins worth adding to your stack in 2026》等指南，标志AI SaaS正向营销、广告行业渗透。Azure《Scale reservoir uncertainty analysis with agile reservoir modeling》将云计算与油气储层不确定性分析结合，打开能源行业上云新场景；火山引擎的 ByteHouse 及数据治理套件面向金融、制造等对实时分析有严格要求的垂直行业。 Salesforce围绕Agentic AI发布《The Humane Agentic Enterprise》和《7 Agentic Service Strategies For Startups》，帮助企业在客服、营销等场景中实现AI代理化；Google Cloud AI基础设施升级为企业提供更易部署的大模型服务，推动金融、制造等传统行业加速AI业务落地，并通过Spend Caps实现成本可控的AI迁移。Azure HSM审计日志与《Microsoft Copilot harness in Foundry Agent Service》帮助企业在合规与 AI 助手双重需求下实现安全上云；Cloudflare 私有源站（Private Origins）GA 为企业提供边缘安全加速，推动更多传统业务迁移至云端。 Salesforce Health Insights: Know What to Fix First
